panels.sample_scope: Fig. 9 | Wind, humidity and multiscale energy during near-peak return and at matched wind speeds. a,b, Recorded wind and 200–800 km mid-level relative humidity. c–e, Horizontal KE, dry APE and same-window APE-to-KE conversion at 700 hPa. f, Net vertical KE input to 500–850 hPa per unit layer mass. Panels c–f use 0–300 km means in the 2–16-day window; positive conversion transfers APE to KE, and positive layer input denotes vertical convergence. Time zero is the last wind minimum before return. Lines average events within each SID, then SIDs; shading shows pointwise 95% intervals from 2,000 SID bootstrap draws on diagnostic-specific support. Counts show SIDs observed within their actual trough-to-return intervals; the fixed-time composites include later observations. g, Ascent-minus-Resolution dry APE at 700 hPa and 0–300 km in three nominal windows (>16 days, 2–16 days and <2 days). Dots and bars show mean differences and 95% SID-bootstrap intervals from 115 events in 108 SIDs, matched within cyclone and common 10 kt wind bins. The vertical line marks zero. Actual-phase endpoint changes, integrated rates, matched comparisons and diagnostic-specific counts are reported in Tables S9a–n.

panels.sample_scope: Fig. 9 | Wind, humidity and multiscale energy during near-peak return and at matched wind speeds. a,b, Recorded wind and 200–800 km mid-level relative humidity. c–e, Horizontal KE, dry APE and same-window APE-to-KE conversion at 700 hPa. f, Net vertical KE input to 500–850 hPa per unit layer mass. Panels c–f use 0–300 km means in the 2–16-day window; positive conversion transfers APE to KE, and positive layer input denotes vertical convergence. Time zero is the last wind minimum before return. Lines average events within each SID, then SIDs; shading shows pointwise 95% intervals from 2,000 SID bootstrap draws on diagnostic-specific support. Counts show SIDs observed within their actual trough-to-return intervals; the fixed-time composites include later observations. g, Ascent-minus-Resolution dry APE at 700 hPa and 0–300 km in three nominal windows (>16 days, 2–16 days and <2 days). Dots and bars show mean differences and 95% SID-bootstrap intervals from 115 events in 108 SIDs, matched within cyclone and common 10 kt wind bins. The vertical line marks zero. Actual-phase endpoint changes, integrated rates, matched comparisons and diagnostic-specific counts are reported in Tables S9a–n.
